law: TG is absolute per-token latency and is model-specific. A smaller model reaching a deeper rung is not a speedup. Kernel promotion requires a same-model before/after.
blocking: No absolute rung may be recorded while the box is contended. Clean-room requires the 24h substrate run and the Virtualization VM to be down.
